text: 01AffordabilityWe've been paying for Washington's poor choices. Wars, reckless tariffs, trade fights. Those choices drove up our costs at the pump and in the store. It didn't have to be this way. These were decisions made, and we can choose differently. Replace them up and down the ballot. Starting here at home. Affordability starts at the ballot box.Read more

02Medicare for AllIf we can afford bombs for perpetual foreign wars, we can afford health care for Americans. As the greatest nation on earth, we have allowed almost every other nation on the planet to outperform us on national health care. We must stop the insurance industrial complex from bleeding Americans dry, both financially and literally. Americans deserve the best health care in the world, whether they are billionaires or blue-collar.Read more

03Money Out of PoliticsWhen Citizens United opened the floodgates, it didn't just change campaign finance, it changed who our system answers to. By treating corporations as people with virtually unlimited spending power, we've allowed concentrated wealth to drown out the voices of everyday citizens. Ending Citizens United isn't just a policy fix; it's a step toward restoring political equality. Making sure elected officials are accountable to the public, not to big donors. It says that democracy belongs to people, not to the highest bidders.Read more
04Education That CompetesMake public education globally competitive again. Modern curriculum, paid trades pathways, and funding to retain great teachers.Read more
05Property Tax Relief for SeniorsLower property taxes for seniors so a lifetime of work doesn't get taxed out of a home. Protect fixed-income residents.Read more
